note: Both sets are bottom-right dark cards with green or amber accents and a vertical timeline once opened. P varies mostly in expanded content (carrier tabs, horizontal stepper with dots, location log), but P1 and P4 are near-identical and all four use the same green. Q varies the collapsed form more (accent-edge pill with 4/5, UP badge, segmented bar, mini dots) and uses amber in two designs, but its expanded views are all the same vertical stepper.
